review_stage: worker research and visual audit; root decisions pending

scope.baseline_note: Assignment referred to initial 40 families. During review root expanded the live plan to 55; candidate relations explicitly identify already-added rows. Current capability baseline remains 64 operations. No new public API is accepted here.

coverage.limits: Collection-level representative review, not a claim to inspect every one of 2205 selected image references. 119 NS atomic product galleries are grouped into 18 actual series/standalone collection groups. Static contact sheets cannot validate dynamics or timing. Full selected Deskriptiv assets had also been inspected during census construction.

method.supplemental_reason: Shared urllib downloader intermittently reset/refused NS/Lomas URLs; direct requests downloads provided review-only copies. No shared receipt or manifest mutation.
method.attribution: Visual inspection establishes appearance/role; algorithm claims use primary text. Captions copied from prior crawl are not automatically accepted. All role corrections below are recommendations for root.
method.collection_definition: Exact artist plus collection_title in owned census works; Nervous System title uses scoped main ol.thumbs hub memberships, never global navigation links.

artist_findings.Nervous System: 18 actual collection groups encompass 119 atomic galleries. Review spans morphology and process roles across groups, not every product angle. Surface growth, reaction patterns, venation, aggregation, articulated Kinematics, puzzle domains and planar Corollaria panels are computationally distinct. Multiple galleries reuse posters/diagrams; repeated bytes do not establish independent variants.
artist_findings.Andy Lomas: 16 image-bearing series/collaboration groups inspected. Cellular, chemical feedback, aggregation and constrained growth need distinct state models. Chromos uses biological contact data and annealing in collaboration with Babraham scientists; reconstruction/optimization remains external research. Yearning for the Infinite is a multiartist show; event views do not isolate Lomas’s contribution.
artist_findings.Robert Hodgin: 22 project groups inspected. Source descriptions support agent, collision, field and geometry families, but most rendering polish depends on materials/lighting. Akari’s final process is procedural profile/rib/paper geometry; a discarded Vellum trial does not make its final output a cloth solver demonstration. Meander satellite and Sol film inputs require exclusion.
artist_findings.Deskriptiv: All nine collection groups inspected; first census task additionally viewed all 70 selected images. Primary descriptions separate woven topology, growth, multimaterial properties and commissioned graphic composition. Wiener Symphoniker images named mushtari2 are visually orchestra posters: filenames alone must not drive attribution.
artist_findings.Quayola: All 51 project groups inspected. The large classical-art corpus includes unchanged historical sources, process comparisons and robot/stone context. Algorithmic painting and scan-derived work require asset/capture boundaries. The appearance of painterly waves cannot establish a fluid solver. Exact analysis, mesh simplification, erosion and temporal painting methods remain underdisclosed.
artist_findings.onformative: 44 relevant project groups inspected. Multiple projects are valid commercial computational applications. Google Faces selects real satellite data using face detection; selected imagery is meaningful output of selection, not generated terrain. Hardware, recording and product photos require their own roles. Audio mapping, motion capture, fluid simulation and data layout remain separate computations.
artist_findings.LIA: 82 image-bearing project groups inspected. Many abstract optical grids, traces, fans and layered ribbons plausibly use ordinary geometry, transform composition and retained drawing history. Titles and appearances do not establish exact algorithms. Physical plotter painting and filament deposition explicitly require material/process boundaries; Weaving’s title is not evidence of interlacing topology.

novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.title: Couple mobile agents to the chemical field they produce
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.relation_to_initial_40_family_plan: New explicit family beyond initial sensor trajectories, RD and supplied-field integration; root has since added row 41.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.source_evidence_paraphrase: Lomas explicitly describes cells following chemical waves while also generating chemical signals, producing feedback. Genetic algorithms and learned exploration navigate parameters, not a substitute description for the simulation.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.artist_task: Couple mobile agents to the chemical field they produce
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.computation_removed: A bounded coupled step with deposition, diffusion/decay, sensing, movement and specified update ordering.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.current_alternative_and_gap: RK4 can follow a supplied field and Gray–Scott can evolve independent concentrations; neither currently expresses agent–field feedback.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.reusable_output: Agent state and chemical grids, independent of rendering.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.meaningful_edit: Change secretion, decay or sensing and verify changed collective behavior.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.transfer_case: Trail-making colonies, chemical signaling and feedback-driven path drawings.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.evidence_limits: Exact artist solver and parameters are not published on the overview. Design an independent bounded model; do not promise exact reproduction.

novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.title: Grow connected cellular structures with division and changing neighbors
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.relation_to_initial_40_family_plan: Split initial row 9: differential surface mechanics and cell-level morphogenesis are not interchangeable.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.source_evidence_paraphrase: Cellular Forms accumulates nutrients, splits a cell above threshold and reconnects daughter and parent to immediate neighbors. Hybrid Forms adds competing cell types; Plantlike Forms changes illumination direction; Vase Forms adds growth/overhang biases.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.artist_task: Grow connected cellular structures with division and changing neighbors
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.computation_removed: Maintain adjacency, nutrients, division events, forces and types as topology changes.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.current_alternative_and_gap: Mesh subdivision refines an existing shape; independent springs and random branch trees do not implement division/reconnection.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.reusable_output: Cell graph or derived surface with stable ancestry and a bounded growth state.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.meaningful_edit: Alter light direction, cell-type properties or division threshold.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.transfer_case: Coral-like sculpture, cellular vessels and constrained biological form studies.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.evidence_limits: Artist reports huge simulations; small browser budgets require explicit limits. Plant-like branching is emergent, not evidence of an L-system.

novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.title: Create controllable woven or knitted surface structures
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.relation_to_initial_40_family_plan: Initial row 40 insufficiently sampled; now explicit primary evidence. Root added row 42.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.source_evidence_paraphrase: DoubleMesh adapts a weave to edited base geometry, controls direction and density, then relaxes overlaps and exports watertight structures. Flyknit adapts a generative knitting structure to surfaces and volumes.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.artist_task: Create controllable woven or knitted surface structures
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.computation_removed: Construct strand/stitch connectivity and over/under relationships, then relax geometry under collision and spacing constraints.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.current_alternative_and_gap: Transported ribbons can draw strands but do not establish valid interlacing or knit topology.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.reusable_output: Editable strand graph, crossing/stitch relationships and derived meshes.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.meaningful_edit: Change weave direction, density and base deformation while preserving relationships.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.transfer_case: Baskets, lattice lamps and textile-derived 3D graphics.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.evidence_limits: Overview does not disclose a full solver. DoubleMesh and knit loops are related but distinct; do not claim every weave method or manufacturing validity. Credit Nike collaborator Everett Vangsnes.

novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.title: Fold articulated panel networks
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.relation_to_initial_40_family_plan: Initial fabrication row 38 hides mechanical state; root added row 43.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.source_evidence_paraphrase: Nervous System explicitly uses Open Dynamics Engine rigid triangular bodies and idealized hinges. A heuristic sequence of collisions folds garments for printer packing, with documented numerical difficulty.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.computation_removed: Construct hinges and rigid bodies, solve their constraints and contacts, retain fold state.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.current_alternative_and_gap: Smooth mesh subdivision and independent target springs lack interconnected rigid hinge constraints and collisions.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.reusable_output: Panel adjacency, hinge axes, rigid transforms and a bounded simulated state.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.meaningful_edit: Change hinge network or folding obstacles and observe mobility/packing differences.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.transfer_case: Articulated jewelry, kinetic panels and folding structures.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.evidence_limits: Do not market this as an optimal fold solver, physically exact cloth or fabrication guarantee; the source expressly uses heuristic folding.

novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.title: Extract visible section lines, outlines and stitch paths from 3D geometry
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.relation_to_initial_40_family_plan: Distinguish geometric extraction from initial rows 19–20 image sampling/hatching; root added row 46.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.source_evidence_paraphrase: Hodgin documents mesh lighting, parallel plane sections, ray-based visibility culling, silhouettes and occlusion contours before resampling into stitches. Thread detail credits Entagma; cloth transfer uses Houdini Vellum.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.artist_task: Extract visible section lines, outlines and stitch paths from 3D geometry
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.computation_removed: Mesh-plane intersections, visibility tests, contour assembly and projection with transferable attributes.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.current_alternative_and_gap: Raster sampling or 2D polygon clipping cannot remove hidden mesh lines or recover geometric sections.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.reusable_output: Visible attributed polylines suitable for drawing, hatching, embroidery or plotting.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.meaningful_edit: Rotate camera or cutting planes while correctly changing hidden-line removal.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.transfer_case: Technical line drawings, etched sculpture and hatch renderers.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.evidence_limits: Stitch construction is downstream and cloth deformation is separate. Source uses several SideFX tools; no claim current toolkit supplies them.

novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.title: Evolve rivers through migration, cutoffs and terrain feedback
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.relation_to_initial_40_family_plan: Initial maps row 32 and erosion row 38 need a separate evolving-network distinction; root added row 45.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.source_evidence_paraphrase: Meander describes curvature-dependent motion and distance-triggered cutoffs producing shrinking oxbow lakes. River Scars extends to tributaries and feeds erosion tools with the evolving river.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.artist_task: Evolve rivers through migration, cutoffs and terrain feedback
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.computation_removed: Advance a curve/network, detect self-contact, perform cutoff topology edits and retain channel history.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.current_alternative_and_gap: Static paths, noise deformation and city parcel graphs do not express migration or oxbow events.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.reusable_output: Channel network, abandoned loops, temporal history and optional terrain forcing fields.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.meaningful_edit: Change migration strength or cutoff distance and inspect event/history differences.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.transfer_case: Imaginary landscapes, historical maps and evolving organic networks.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.evidence_limits: Hodgin uses Houdini/Gaea erosion; primary text does not specify an independent hydrological solver. Scope a visual model without scientific accuracy claims.

novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.title: Break a curved surface into flat, connectable panels
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.relation_to_initial_40_family_plan: Clarify initial fabrication row 38; distinct from new rigid-hinge dynamics.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.source_evidence_paraphrase: Corollaria Gyroid comprises 121 flat aluminum panels and 1789 rivets. Source describes a custom system splitting a surface into puzzle-piece panels that assemble without forming or jigs.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.artist_task: Break a curved surface into flat, connectable panels
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.computation_removed: Partition a surface, compute planar panel geometry and mating/assembly relationships under a declared approximation model.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.current_alternative_and_gap: Existing meshes and 2D offsets can draw parts but do not decide surface partitioning, flattening or assembly connectivity.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.reusable_output: 2D panels plus adjacency and correspondence back to the target surface.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.meaningful_edit: Change panel size or approximation tolerance while retaining mating information.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.transfer_case: Paper sculptures, modular lamps and architectural maquettes.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.evidence_limits: Source does not disclose optimization details; exact method needs research. Gyroid formula itself belongs under implicit-field composition, not a separate algorithm family.

novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.title: Run growth and adjacency on periodic or otherwise identified domains
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.relation_to_initial_40_family_plan: Initial seamless-tiling row 17 understates topology/state; root added row 44.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.source_evidence_paraphrase: The artist explicitly says Infinity Puzzle’s simulation wraps like a torus, allowing top/bottom and left/right pieces to continue without edges.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.artist_task: Run growth and adjacency on periodic or otherwise identified domains
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.computation_removed: Apply boundary identification consistently to neighbor queries, growth, paths and exported seam connectivity.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.current_alternative_and_gap: Repeating an already-rendered raster does not ensure a growing structure or graph joins across a seam.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.meaningful_edit: Move a seed across a boundary and preserve topology and continuity.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.transfer_case: Tileable growth, periodic agent worlds and puzzle layouts.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.evidence_limits: Torus is explicitly evidenced here; Earth/Moon titles alone do not establish projective-plane or non-Euclidean algorithms. Prefer composing ordinary modulo coordinates where sufficient.

novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.title: Represent spatially varying material properties and internal channels
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.relation_to_initial_40_family_plan: Make limits of initial lit-mesh row 33 and fabrication row 38 explicit.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.source_evidence_paraphrase: Vespers describes spatially varying physical material properties; Living Mushtari includes internal channels, not just a colored exterior mesh.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.artist_task: Represent spatially varying material properties and internal channels
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.computation_removed: Retain material/property fields and inner geometry separately from the visible surface.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.current_alternative_and_gap: Surface colors, UV maps and a watertight exterior cannot encode the full volume or multiple physical properties.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.reusable_output: Multi-channel volume/property field and queryable internal geometry.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.meaningful_edit: Alter an internal channel or material distribution without conflating it with surface shading.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.transfer_case: Scientific material visualization and heterogeneous artifact design.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.evidence_limits: Fabrication and material behavior remain external. Vespers credits MIT Mediated Matter/Neri Oxman and Stratasys; do not attribute the complete project solely to Deskriptiv.

novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.title: Separate plotted paths from physical paint and filament behavior
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.relation_to_initial_40_family_plan: Clarify expressive strokes row 22, plotting row 20 and fabrication row 38.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.source_evidence_paraphrase: LIA controls the plotter Z axis while manually applying ink/watercolor; the physical brush and paint create variation. Filament Sculptures uses simultaneous XYZ movement and flowing/self-organizing extrusion.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.artist_task: Separate plotted paths from physical paint and filament behavior
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.computation_removed: For geometric support, preserve 3D deposition trajectories and attributes; predicting material output would require a separate physical model.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.current_alternative_and_gap: A 2D polyline can reproduce a path but not pressure, paint viscosity, brush loading or unsupported filament dynamics.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.reusable_output: Timed trajectories with height/material attributes; optional external fabrication handoff.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.meaningful_edit: Edit height or deposition rate while keeping centerline fixed.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.transfer_case: Brush plotting, nonplanar printing and simulated stroke research.
novel_or_refined_algorithm_needs.evidence_limits: Do not promise recreation of these physical works from a line renderer. Machine control and physical-material solvers require separate contracts.

composition_and_boundary_decisions.case: LIA optical grids, arcs, ribbons and trace accumulation
composition_and_boundary_decisions.recommendation: Start with composed transforms, paths, styles and retained drawing. Do not add an algorithm for each title or assume a fluid/noise solver from appearance.
Keep point-cloud assets, input recordings, temporal transformation and final painting separate. Primary overview descriptions justify research needs but not exact solver claims.

Profile geometry, rib/spiral construction, noise displacement and ordinary shader composition are useful recipes. Do not infer cloth simulation for Akari from an abandoned experiment or use the Sunshine film frame as output.

composition_and_boundary_decisions.case: onformative Google Faces and audio/data commissions
composition_and_boundary_decisions.recommendation: Computational selection of external images and measured signals are legitimate artist tasks; distinguish selection/acquisition adapters from image synthesis.
Optimization/search over a generator is distinct from the generator; preserve external scientist credit and data provenance. Overview evidence alone does not specify a reusable annealing contract.
